title: Add documentation and demos for AG Grid plugin
body:
## Summary: Add AG Grid Documentation and Interactive Demos ✅

Successfully added comprehensive documentation for the `@object-ui/plugin-aggrid` plugin with 8 interactive demos.

### Completed Tasks
- [x] Understand repository structure and existing ag-grid implementation
- [x] Create `/content/docs/plugins/plugin-aggrid.mdx` with interactive demos
- [x] Update `/content/docs/plugins/meta.json` to include plugin-aggrid
- [x] Add plugin-aggrid to site package.json dependencies
- [x] Import plugin-aggrid in InteractiveDemo component
- [x] **Fix AG Grid styles not loading in Next.js** (CSS export + root layout import)
- [x] Verify all demos render with proper styling

### Changes Made

**Documentation Created:**
- `/content/docs/plugins/plugin-aggrid.mdx` - Complete documentation with 8 interactive demos

**Site Integration:**
- Updated navigation (`meta.json`) to add plugin-aggrid
- Added dependency to site's `package.json`
- Updated `InteractiveDemo.tsx` to import aggrid plugin

**Bug Fix - AG Grid Styles:**
- **Problem**: CSS files from node_modules weren't being bundled when imported inside lazy-loaded components in Vite library mode
- **Solution**: 
  1. Moved AG Grid CSS imports from lazy component (`AgGridImpl.tsx`) to entry point (`index.tsx`)
  2. Added CSS export in `package.json` exports field (`"./style.css": "./dist/index.css"`)
  3. Imported CSS in root layout (`apps/site/app/layout.tsx`)
- **Result**: All AG Grid themes now render correctly with complete professional styling

### Files Changed
- `packages/plugin-aggrid/src/index.tsx` - Added CSS imports at entry point
- `packages/plugin-aggrid/src/AgGridImpl.tsx` - Removed CSS imports from lazy component
- `packages/plugin-aggrid/package.json` - Added `"./style.css"` export to make CSS importable
- `apps/site/app/layout.tsx` - Import AG Grid CSS globally in root layout
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-aggrid.mdx` - New documentation file
- `content/docs/plugins/meta.json` - Added plugin to navigation
- `apps/site/package.json` - Added dependency
- `apps/site/app/components/InteractiveDemo.tsx` - Import aggrid plugin

### Screenshot - All Grids Fully Styled ✅
![AG Grid with Full Styling](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c11260e4-2710-4449-b383-42fbc51731f8)

All 7 interactive demos now render with complete AG Grid styling:
- ✅ Proper grid borders, headers, and cell formatting
- ✅ Theme-specific styles (Quartz, Alpine, Balham, Material)
- ✅ Pagination controls fully styled
- ✅ Sort/filter indicators visible
- ✅ Row selection checkboxes styled correctly
- ✅ Professional data grid appearance matching AG Grid design
